headline: 126 goals: Messi officially retires from Argentina, ends 21-year career
summary: The football legend bid farewell to the national team in an emotional 3-0 win over Benin at the Monumental stadium, marked by fireworks and drone shows.
details: Lionel Messi officially ended his 21-year international career in front of 85,000 fans at the Monumental stadium in Buenos Aires. The farewell was a massive celebration featuring live music, fireworks, and a drone show that illuminated the night sky.
caption:
A 21-year journey ends. Lionel Messi signs off from the Argentina national team with one final goal and two assists.

Lionel Messi officially ended his 21-year international career in front of 85,000 fans at the Monumental stadium in Buenos Aires. The farewell was a massive celebration featuring live music, fireworks, and a drone show that illuminated the night sky.

headline_marked: CCTV shows [[police officer helping drug dealer Raja escape]] in Dhaka
headline: CCTV shows police officer helping drug dealer Raja escape in Dhaka
summary: A sub-inspector is seen in footage as he helps the notorious drug dealer 'Pichi Raja' flee from a prison van in the middle of a busy Dhaka street.
details: CCTV footage has revealed that a police sub-inspector (SI) helped notorious drug dealer Raja, also known as 'Pichi Raja', escape from a prison van on a busy street in Tanti Bazar, Dhaka.

The incident occurred on September 27 during a transfer of 30 prisoners to Kashimpur Jail. The footage shows SI Prabir Kumar Biswas opening the back door of the van during a traffic jam near Popular Diagnostic Centre.

The officer is seen escorting Pichi Raja out of the vehicle and walking with him toward a waiting private car, while another prisoner, Khairul Bashar, was briefly let out before returning to the driver's seat for air conditioning.
Police investigations reveal the plan was coordinated two days prior, involving the driver of the prison van, Nayek Kamal Hossain, and the drug dealer's sister, Taslima.
SI Prabir Kumar Biswas, the driver Nayek Kamal Hossain, and Taslima have been arrested and placed on a four-day remand by the Gazipur Metropolitan Magistrate's Court.
Gazipur Metropolitan Police Commissioner Israel Hawladar confirmed that Pichi Raja, who faces 30 separate cases, is still at large and border surveillance has been increased to capture him.
Pichi Raja had previously been arrested at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport on May 19 after returning from Nepal with his wife and sister-in-law.
caption:
A police officer is caught on camera helping a notorious drug dealer escape from a prison van in broad daylight.

CCTV footage has revealed that a police sub-inspector (SI) helped notorious drug dealer Raja, also known as 'Pichi Raja', escape from a prison van on a busy street in Tanti Bazar, Dhaka.

The incident occurred on September 27 during a transfer of 30 prisoners to Kashimpur Jail. The footage shows SI Prabir Kumar Biswas opening the back door of the van during a traffic jam near Popular Diagnostic Centre.

The officer is seen escorting Pichi Raja out of the vehicle and walking with him toward a waiting private car, while another prisoner, Khairul Bashar, was briefly let out before returning to the driver's seat for air conditioning.

Police investigations reveal the plan was coordinated two days prior, involving the driver of the prison van, Nayek Kamal Hossain, and the drug dealer's sister, Taslima.

SI Prabir Kumar Biswas, the driver Nayek Kamal Hossain, and Taslima have been arrested and placed on a four-day remand by the Gazipur Metropolitan Magistrate's Court.

Gazipur Metropolitan Police Commissioner Israel Hawladar confirmed that Pichi Raja, who faces 30 separate cases, is still at large and border surveillance has been increased to capture him.

Pichi Raja had previously been arrested at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport on May 19 after returning from Nepal with his wife and sister-in-law.
